definitions.gloss: company director, member of the board of directors
definitions.explanation: A person elected by shareholders to serve on the board of directors of a corporation. Responsible for major business decisions and oversight of company management. A formal legal title under Japanese corporate law.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{取締役|とりしまりやく}に{就任|しゅうにん}した。
examples.english: He was appointed as a company director.

examples.japanese: {取締役会|とりしまりやくかい}で{新|あたら}しい{方針|ほうしん}が{決定|けってい}された。
examples.english: A new policy was decided at the board of directors meeting.

examples.japanese: {同社|どうしゃ}は{社外|しゃがい}{取締役|とりしまりやく}を{二名|にめい}{新|あら}たに{迎|むか}え、ガバナンスの{強化|きょうか}を{図|はか}る。
examples.english: The company will newly appoint two outside directors to strengthen governance.

notes:
USAGE:
{取締役|とりしまりやく} is a formal legal title used in Japanese corporate law ({会社法|かいしゃほう}). The word is commonly abbreviated in compound titles.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {取締役会|とりしまりやくかい}: board of directors (meeting)
- {代表取締役|だいひょうとりしまりやく}: representative director (CEO equivalent)
- {社外|しゃがい}{取締役|とりしまりやく}: outside director
- {常務|じょうむ}{取締役|とりしまりやく}: managing director
- {専務|せんむ}{取締役|とりしまりやく}: senior managing director
- {取締役|とりしまりやく}に{就任|しゅうにん}する: to be appointed as director
